svg.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark training loss at peak learning rates 6e-4 and 3e-4
svg.desc: Left: the first 3,300 steps, including the loss jump from 0.926 at step 2,110 to 3.239 at step 2,130 with peak LR 6e-4. Right: all available records, with peak LR 3e-4 reaching loss 0.610 at step 26,040. Raw logged data without smoothing.
